description: Source code for a Prometheus Go collector module that gathers runtime memory statistics and garbage collection metrics.

classes.name: baseGoCollector
classes.description: Struct holding descriptions for Go runtime metrics such as goroutines, threads, and garbage collection.

methods.name: goRuntimeMemStats
methods.description: Returns memory statistics metrics based on runtime.ReadMemStats, compatible with Go 1.17+ runtime/metrics.

methods.name: newBaseGoCollector
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new baseGoCollector with metric descriptions.
